SD67-003.name: Ultimate-Odin-Striker
SD67-003.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Incarnate Spirits/Ultimates, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks/Blocks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, you can return two opposing Spirits/Nexuses to the deckbottom.
[utb]

[LV4][LV5]
Give all your "Incarnate" family Ultimates: "[Heavy Armor: Green/White] This Ultimate is unaffected by opposing Green/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."

SD67-006.name: The Debris Reef
SD67-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Put a core from the Void to any of your "Incarnate" family Spirits/Ultimates.

[LV2]
While you control any "Incarnate" family Ultimates, the opponent can't attack unless they send a core from their Reserve to their Trash.

SD67-007.name: The Space Station Kiraboshi
SD67-007.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Core])]
[During Set] (Your Turn)
While you have six counters or more, if the total cost of the cards sent to the Trash by your Ultimate Trigger is 5 or more, you can return an "Incarnate" family card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1]
When your "Incarnate" family Ultimate is summoned/[Contract Advents], your counter +1. Also, (Once per Turn: Same Name) draw a card.

SD67-001.name: Ultimate-Beelzebeat-Eques
SD67-001.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Incarnate Spirits/Ultimates, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned/Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.
[utb]

[LV4][LV5] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Incarnate" family Ultimate attacks, you can pay one cost to summon a Cost 4 or less Spirit card from your Trash.

SD67-008.name: Ultimate Cross Slash
SD67-008.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Including in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Mugen", the effects of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't activate.

SD67-002.name: Ultimate-Mugendra
SD67-002.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Extreme Contract, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit/Ultimate.

[Summon Condition: You control one or more “Mugen”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[Count Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Advents/Attacks)]
When Count Ultimate Trigger hits, put two cores from the Void to this Ultimate.
[cutb]

[During OC & During Advent] [LV3][LV4] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Incarnate" family Ultimate attacks, your counter +1. Also, while your Ultimate is attacking, if your counter is five or more, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.

SD67-005.name: Ultimate-Mugendragon-Cosmo
SD67-005.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Extreme Contract & C2 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit/Ultimate.

[Summon Condition: You control one or more “Mugen”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[LV3][LV4] (When Advents/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost.

[During OC] [Count Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Count Ultimate Trigger hits, you can pay one cost to summon an "Incarnate" family Ultimate card from your Hand.
[cutb]

SD67-X01.name: Ultimate-Mugendragon-Maxstar
SD67-X01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Extreme Contract & C6 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit/Ultimate.

[Summon Condition: You control one or more "Mugen", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[Double Count Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Advents/Attacks)]
For each Count Ultimate Trigger hits, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two symbols or less. [Double Hit] When it hits twice, this effect can't be prevented by opposing effects, and effects of the Spirits destroyed by this effect can't activate.
[dcutb]

[During OC & During Advent] [LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
For every 6 costs of the combined cost of the cards hit by your Double Count Ultimate Trigger, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. (Max. 3)

SD67-004.name: Ultimate-Rean-Machina
SD67-004.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Incarnate Spirits/Ultimates, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, put two cores from the Void to your Life.
[utb]

[LV4][LV5] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Incarnate" family Ultimates are destroyed via BP comparison, they remain on the Field, exhausted.

SD67-CX01.name: Star Buddy, Mugen
SD67-CX01.effect:
[CArule]

[Soul State] [Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2]
(Can't Stack) After your Ultimate Trigger resolves, you can draw a card. Also, if the hit card is Cost 7 or more, during this battle, that Ultimate gains an extra Red symbol.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, if you have 4 counters or more, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest BP.
